statement: Build a one-page website for Brew Lab, a cafe in Indiranagar, Bengaluru, that shows the menu, hours and location, takes pre-orders for pickup, and features a large photo gallery of the cafe and a detailed story section for each of its three coffee farms, at low cost.
audience: Cafe customers and coffee lovers in and around Indiranagar, Bengaluru, mostly on mobile phones, who want to see what is served, when and where the cafe is open, order ahead for pickup, and learn where the coffee comes from.
standards: Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file, no build step; CDN libraries allowed
Mobile-first, responsive layout that is readable on a phone
Single page with a navigation that jumps to each section
Every image has alt text and below-the-fold images are lazy-loaded
Low cost: no paid services, API keys or subscriptions required to run the page
Any content fact not supplied is shown as a visibly marked placeholder, never invented
rules: Pre-order is for pickup only; no delivery option appears
Do not invent prices, phone numbers, addresses, farm names, farm facts or photos
Every placeholder is visibly marked (for example 'PLACEHOLDER: add ...') so it cannot be mistaken for real content
The gallery and the farm stories are both required; neither is traded off for the other
done_when: The site is a single HTML file with inline or CDN-loaded CSS and JavaScript and no build step
The file has a navigation linking to sections for Menu, Hours, Location, Pre-order, Gallery and Farms
The Menu section lists items grouped by category, with each price present or marked as a placeholder
The Hours section lists opening times for all seven days, or marks them as placeholders
The Location section names Indiranagar, Bengaluru, and has an address (or marked placeholder) and a map link or embed
The Pre-order section has a form with item selection, quantity, customer name, phone and pickup time, and produces an order summary; it offers no delivery option
The Gallery section has at least 12 image slots shown in a large grid, each with alt text, and an enlarged view when an image is clicked
The Farms section has three separate farm blocks, each with a name (or marked placeholder), location, a story of at least three paragraphs or labelled subsections, and an image slot
The layout includes responsive CSS rules for narrow phone screens
Every unsupplied fact in the file is visibly marked as a placeholder, and the file contains no API keys or paid-service dependencies
open_inputs: Phone or WhatsApp number and the channel through which pre-orders reach the cafe
Pickup lead time and any order cutoff
Names and locations of the three coffee farms
Story content for each farm (history, people, growing and processing methods)
Cafe photos for the gallery and farm photos
Logo, brand colours and tagline, if any
